function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values — 48 patients appear more than once, with `sample_seq` > 1. The data dictionary says: 'A patient who was re-tested appears twice. The row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient.'", "implication": "We must deduplicate the dataset by `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient. Otherwise, we will double-count re-tested patients and distort the mean. This changes the analysis plan: we must group by `patient_id` and select the max `sample_seq` row before computing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
